The two highest-consequence finds were not on the brief: a live Vercel link that would publish the entire internal strategy repo from a root deploy, and the customer-facing masters set (_smartsite_masters, nine ratified status:active docs) being entirely untracked, so the approved-claims register OPS-17 binds every lane artifact against does not survive a clone.

countingRuleAdopted.rule: Every directory row carries FOUR MEASURED values: fs (find -type f), tracked (git ls-files), untracked (git ls-files --others --exclude-standard), ignored (git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard). Never three plus a subtraction.
countingRuleAdopted.why: Measuring untracked as a subtraction is how a deliberate, correct exclusion gets misread as an omission. It happened TWICE while building this map, both times against gitignored confidential PDFs, and both times a sub-agent caught the planner. The four-value rule is the direct fix.
countingRuleAdopted.identity: fs = tracked + untracked + ignored holds for every directory EXCEPT the two nested foreign git clones, where it cannot: files inside a nested repo are invisible to the parent git entirely — neither tracked, untracked, nor ignored.
countingRuleAdopted.snapshotCaveat: _inbox was measured at 2,620 / 2,621 / 2,623 / 2,626 within one session because concurrent lanes write to it continuously. Those are four correct measurements of a moving population, not a discrepancy. Every _inbox figure is timestamped 2026-08-14.

topFindings.title: _smartsite_masters/ is entirely untracked — nine ratified status:active masters
topFindings.evidence: fs=13 tracked=0 untracked=11 ignored=2. git check-ignore attributes only the 2 PDFs; the .md files match no ignore rule. 06_gtm edited 2026-08-10 and still uncommitted. Its README names _smartcity_masters/ its companion set reciprocally: "professional pitches come from this folder, city pitches from that one."

topFindings.title: Untracked stale duplicate of the ratified reference set, with a live pricing contradiction
topFindings.evidence: Master Collateral Folder/_smartcity_masters/ — verified file-by-file with diff -q: five of six files differ, root newer on all five (2026-08-10 vs 2026-08-01). Duplicate 00_README.md:61 lists government pricing under "## Owed" as an open operator decision; tracked root line 66 reads "## Pricing — SET 2026-08-10".
topFindings.consequence: A reader of the untracked copy reports a settled, Vertosoft-submitted MSRP decision as still open. This is a shadow copy of the folder whose own README claims tiebreak authority over every other doc in the repo.

topFindings.title: 216 files exist on this machine only
topFindings.evidence: Untracked AND unignored: atx_bulls 197, _rd_digital_economies 10, _sales 6, _thought_leadership 3. Three edited 2026-08-13 or 08-14. Plus _scratch 475 untracked / 140 MB and not gitignored, 5 of 10 scripts, all 3 factory runbooks, 4 decision records, ADR-028, 4 session summaries.

The sharpest single case: 00_current_state.md — the file every session is required to open with — points into _thought_leadership, which does not survive a clone.

topFindings.title: Two nested foreign git clones, one already ruled and never executed
topFindings.evidence: hauska-mcp-server/ — remote hauska-mcp-server.git, HEAD 080eb01 (2026-07-02), 185 of 186 files invisible to parent git. .gitignore:12-13 carries the ruling verbatim: "Stray full clone of the product repo left inside doc_repo; product code, not strategy. Do not commit; delete the clone." tmpbrief-l3-spine-consume/ — remote hauska-brief-extension.git (a DIFFERENT repo), HEAD fc46920 (2026-07-16), 188 files invisible, and NOT ignored, NOT tracked, undocumented anywhere.
topFindings.consequence: These 373 files are why filesystem and git counts diverge by more than untracked explains. Bounded at two — verified by find -name .git to depth 3.

topFindings.title: The Command Center has 231 mentions, 116 of them in _inbox, and NO authoritative doc
topFindings.evidence: authoritativeDoc: null. Authority split across eight documents with nothing composing them. Mechanical cause: 00c_portfolio_master_map.md, whose job is to enumerate surfaces, does not list the Command Center as a surface — it mentions only "a scaffolded command-center app" consuming the SDK. Only one file carries command_center in its name at a canonical band position (OPS-6).
topFindings.residualRisk: Docs disagree with themselves on build state. County Ledger v2 shipped 2026-08-04 and the rail-derivation fix landed 2026-08-12, but OPS-6 (2026-08-02) still records Resolver and Autonomous Engines as explicit stubs. Cert View — where a REQUIRED certification gate physically happens — may be unwired.

topFindings.title: The _inbox courier sweep has never run, and the retention rule that fixes it already has a hand-set precedent
topFindings.evidence: _inbox/README.md:56-63 documents a sweep ("Deletes the inbox file once filed"). 2,276 files loose at top level spanning twelve weeks. Evidence-dependency scan: of 114 distinct cited artifacts, 113 are .json summaries and exactly ONE is a writer-run .log — while .log is simultaneously the largest class (929 files) and the least committed (872 untracked). Precedent: _inbox/wave3_attempt1_archive/ holds exactly 241 files, all logs, none tracked, swept wholesale by the operator.
topFindings.consequence: The repo already voted with its index: logs were never committed, closes and summaries were. A retention rule that generalizes an existing operator decision is far safer than one that invents policy. But the rule treats the symptom — without restoring the sweep as a HOOK-shaped control, _inbox regrows at ~1,494 files per half-month. This repo's measured base rate is prose controls 0-for-3, hooks 1-for-1.
